question: I elected to take 67-272 (Application Design and Development) as Pass/Fail this semester. I received a P grade. Does this satisfy the prerequisite for 67-373 (Information Systems Consulting Project)?
expected_answer: This is uncertain and requires verification. The prerequisite for 67-373 requires 67-272 at least D. A P (Pass) grade typically corresponds to at least a D performance. However, CMU's policy states that P/N courses do not count toward major/minor requirements. Whether a P grade satisfies a prerequisite (as opposed to a graduation requirement) may be handled differently — the system may or may not recognize a P grade as satisfying a letter-grade threshold prerequisite. The student should consult their advisor and the registrar to confirm.
reasoning_type: P/N grade interaction with prerequisite thresholds
common_mistake: Assuming P grade always satisfies a 'D or better' threshold prerequisite; not distinguishing between P/N counting for graduation requirements vs. prerequisite enforcement
